product: Mission-critical connectivity where terrestrial networks do not reach: commercial IoT and voice/data, U.S. government EMSS, Iridium PNT ASIC (available 2026-07-14), standards-based Iridium NTN Direct direct-to-device (Deutsche Telekom and Toyota demo 2026-09-10), and Aireon space-based aviation surveillance (closed 2026-07-02). 2,627,000 billable subscribers reported 2026-07-22.
demand: Both. On 2026-07-22 Iridium reported commercial IoT data revenue up 5% on 9% more subscribers (volume), commercial voice and data up 3% on higher ARPU from prior-year price actions (price), hosted payload and other data up 14% (mix), while commercial broadband declined; total revenue up 4% to $225.2M.
pricing_power: Costs after closing: term-loan pricing rises to SOFR plus 2.50 to 3.00 percent plus a 1 percent exit fee and 1 percent repricing premium (2026-09-15). Also Aireon integration, next-generation constellation capex, all-cash incentive comp adding $3.9M, and legal and transaction costs pushing Q2 SG&A to $67.0M from $44.6M (2026-07-22). FY2025 OEBITDA margin was 57% (2026-06-29).
competition: Not found. No primary source read shows a dated Chinese low-cost Iridium substitute. The closest documented substitute is regional direct-to-device over cellular spectrum, which Iridium says is limited by geographic availability (2026-09-10); Chinese Guowang or Qianfan claims are context only and undated here.
market_strategy: Matt Desch, 2026-09-24: appreciated stockholder support and looks forward to completing the transaction. Management promised: merger close by mid-2027 (2026-06-29); EMSS renewal by March 2027 and Aireon adding at least $100M service revenue and $30M OEBITDA annualized (2026-07-22); Iridium NTN Direct commercial availability in Q4 2026 (2026-09-10).
bull: Stockholders approved the Rocket Lab merger 2026-09-24 (99.6% of votes, 81% outstanding); shares at $48.75 versus $54.00 notional, with close guided mid-2027 and Aireon adding $100M revenue and $30M OEBITDA annualized.
bear: It is merger arb, not fundamentals: Q2 revenue only +4% to $225.2M, SG&A jumped to $67.0M from $44.6M, and regulatory approval, EMSS renewal by March 2027 and NTN Direct Q4 2026 launch all remain undelivered.
falsifier: Regulatory approval denied or the Rocket Lab merger terminated or renegotiated before the guided mid-2027 close, or the $54.00 spread widening materially on deal risk.

Last 90d: 2026-06-29 merger announced at $54.00/share; 2026-07-02 Aireon closed; 2026-07-22 Q2 revenue $225.2M up 4%.
web_true_now_not_modelled: It is a merger-arb situation, not a fundamentals story: 2026-09-24 approval done, regulatory approvals pending, close guided mid-2027, yet shares closed $48.75 on 2026-09-25 versus $54.00 notional (stockanalysis; 8-K). Aireon closed 2026-07-02 adds about $100M revenue and $30M OEBITDA annualized, absent from a full reported quarter (2026-07-22).
web_demand_product: Mission-critical connectivity where terrestrial networks do not reach: commercial IoT and voice/data, U.S. government EMSS, Iridium PNT ASIC (available 2026-07-14), standards-based Iridium NTN Direct direct-to-device (Deutsche Telekom and Toyota demo 2026-09-10), and Aireon space-based aviation surveillance (closed 2026-07-02). 2,627,000 billable subscribers reported 2026-07-22.

web_bottleneck: The company bottleneck is constellation replenishment and launch access; the 2026-06-29 deal says Rocket Lab eliminates third-party launch costs and guarantees orbital access as launch capacity tightens. The bottleneck it relieves is coverage: pole-to-pole L-band reach, plus GPS and GNSS jamming and spoofing that Iridium PNT addresses (2026-07-14, 2026-09-24).
web_who_benefits_next: Rocket Lab shareholders (RKLB), and Rocket Lab USA which guarantees the credit facility at closing (2026-09-15), plus Rocket Lab suppliers and Neutron; Deutsche Telekom IoT, Nordic Semiconductor and Fraunhofer (2026-09-10); Toyota; Aireon CEO Don Thoma (2026-07-06). Sector-wide re-rating followed the Amazon-Globalstar report from about 2026-04-02 (2026-09-18 8-K).
web_who_loses: Rival direct-to-device and satellite operators: SpaceX Starlink direct-to-cell, Amazon-Globalstar, AST SpaceMobile and regional cellular-spectrum satellite players that Iridium contrasts against its global L-band (2026-09-10). Terrestrial mobile operators also lose IoT roaming revenue unless they partner, as Deutsche Telekom did (2026-09-10).

web_ceo_promised: Matt Desch, 2026-09-24: appreciated stockholder support and looks forward to completing the transaction. Management promised: merger close by mid-2027 (2026-06-29); EMSS renewal by March 2027 and Aireon adding at least $100M service revenue and $30M OEBITDA annualized (2026-07-22); Iridium NTN Direct commercial availability in Q4 2026 (2026-09-10).
web_did_they_deliver: Partly. Delivered: Aireon closed 2026-07-02; stockholder approval 2026-09-24; NTN Direct advanced from Mlink live testing 2026-06-24 to the Deutsche Telekom and Toyota voice demo 2026-09-10. Open, with no delivery evidence yet: merger close by mid-2027, EMSS renewal by March 2027, NTN Direct commercial launch, and Aireon $100M revenue and $30M OEBITDA annualized targets.
web_what_would_falsify: Observables: regulatory approval denied or the merger terminated or renegotiated (close guided mid-2027); EMSS Contract not renewed by March 2027; Iridium NTN Direct not commercially available in Q4 2026; Aireon failing the $100M service-revenue and $30M OEBITDA annualized target; or the IRDM price-to-$54.00 spread widening materially on deal risk.
